partner_result_applied.scope_used: continuity is separate from interval domination; fixed-instance principal-block L-infinity transfer

additional_premises.scope: invertible principal 3/4 blocks and affine conditional density bounds
definite physical 2x2 pair bound with arbitrary outside couplings

new_results.statement: If coordinate i has a disjoint invertible 3x3/4x4 principal block or a disjoint definite 2x2 principal block, changing only f_i to g_i changes the output density in L-infinity by at most K_i ||f_i-g_i||_1.

If every physical coordinate has such a disjoint smoothing block, then for arbitrary measurable independent densities 0<=f_i<=1 the output density has a C_0 representative; no input continuity is required.
Every rank-at-least-five target matrix yields a bounded uniformly continuous C_0 output density for arbitrary admissible product inputs.

central_unresolved_implication: Prove a dimension-free interval small-ball estimate on the finite-fragment product-extreme class for every target-admissible rotated/indefinite A.
continuity_unresolved_implication: Handle rank-three/rank-four matrices having a coordinate deletion that is hyperbolic rank two or rank at most one; in exact rank three deletion failure requires leverage one.
next_step: Classify the low-rank leverage-one normal forms and attack them with direct bilinear/two-sheet smoothing; do not repeat the generic approximation mechanism.
